text: This solution, Disaster and Climate Resilience Improvement Project (DCRIP) addresses natural catastrophe in Pakistan between Government of Pakistan, National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Provincial Disaster Management Authorities (PDMAs), and World Bank (International Development Association - IDA). The program was implemented in 2015 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
